description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Type text via the clipboard (IME-safe; never echoes the typed text). Waits at least 1.5 s after writing the Mac clipboard before ⌘V, because the phone reads it through Universal Clipboard and an earlier ⌘V can paste the phone's own older clipboard instead; after type_not_confirmed, read the field — it may hold that older text. If another app comes to the front during the wait: focus_lost, no ⌘V; the clipboard is put back unless something else copied during the wait. Refused with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed. Saves every clipboard item and type, clearing concealed or transient items instead of copying, and restores only after OCR sees the text appear within its 2.5 s check at a spot where it was not before, below the status bar and notification strip — only that sighting makes the result delivered_verified (Universal Clipboard or >64 MB items are not copied and leave the typed text on the clipboard; a text under four characters, spaces and case aside, a paste seen only after the 2.5 s check, and type_not_confirmed are never verified and also leave the typed text on the clipboard). replace=true selects all and overwrites the field. Refused with keyboard_layout (nothing sent, clipboard untouched) when the Mac's keyboard layout types another character on the key ⌘V or ⌘A is sent from (AZERTY, Dvorak). Optional expect: on-screen text (OCR), else nothing is sent. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_type
